providers.name: Cerebras
providers.description: Inference provider leveraging Cerebras' wafer-scale hardware to deliver extremely high token throughput (thousands of tokens per second) for select open models.

providers.name: Cloudflare
providers.description: Cloudflare's global edge network serving Workers AI models, including their AI Gateway for routing and observability across providers.

providers.name: Cohere
providers.description: Cohere's API platform for the Command and Aya model families, specializing in RAG, multilingual, and enterprise use cases.

providers.name: Deepinfra
providers.description: Community-driven inference provider offering pay-per-token access to hundreds of open models with minimal hosting markup.

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.description: DeepSeek's official API for their frontier models (DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1) offering competitive pricing for both chat and reasoning workloads.

providers.name: GitHub Models
providers.description: GitHub's model playground and API offering free access to popular models from multiple providers running on Azure AI infrastructure.

providers.name: Google AI
providers.description: Google's official API for the Gemini and Gemma model families, providing free-tier access with generous rate limits and multimodal support.

providers.name: Groq
providers.description: LPU-based inference provider delivering ultra-low latency (hundreds of tokens per second) for open models running on custom hardware.

providers.name: LLM Gateway
providers.description: Open-source API gateway providing a unified OpenAI-compatible interface for calling open-weight models from various inference backends.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.description: Mistral AI's official API platform for their frontier models (Mistral Large, Codestral, Ministral) with competitive free-tier access.

providers.name: Novitaai
providers.description: Novita AI's API platform providing inference for open models with competitive free-tier pricing and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

providers.name: NVIDIA
providers.description: NVIDIA's API platform providing high-performance inference for open models running on their GPU infrastructure, including the Nemotron and Llama families.

providers.name: OpenCode Zen
providers.description: OpenCode Zen API — focused on fast, affordable inference for coding and agentic workloads running on optimized infrastructure.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.description: Multi-provider API gateway offering unified access to 300+ models across dozens of providers with a single API key, standardized billing, and automatic failover.

providers.name: SiliconFlow
providers.description: Chinese inference provider offering competitive pricing for open models, with strong coverage of Qwen and DeepSeek model variants.

providers.name: xAI
providers.description: xAI's official API for the Grok model family — frontier models with real-time knowledge and strong reasoning.

providers.name: Zhipu AI
providers.description: Zhipu AI's official API for the GLM model family with strong Chinese-English bilingual capabilities and multimodal support.

issues.issue: opencode zen free tier has a fixed request limit per billing period. Once reached, all requests are blocked until the quota resets.
issues.impact: Cannot use opencode zen for model queries until quota resets.
issues.workaround: Wait for quota reset, switch to a different provider, or upgrade to a paid plan.

issues.issue: HuggingFace Router free tier has very low rate limits — a few requests per day for unauthenticated users, slightly more with a token. All HF Router models hit 429s quickly in practice.
issues.impact: All HuggingFace Router models are rate-limited in practice, even though they technically work.
issues.workthrough: Authenticate with a HF token for marginally higher limits, or use models through other providers (e.g. the same models on OpenRouter).

issues.issue: Returns extra fields in assistant messages: reasoning, reasoning_details
issues.impact: Causes schema validation errors in strict OpenAI-compatible clients that reject unknown properties
issues.workaround: Use through OpenRouter opencode gateway, or configure client to ignore/strip unknown fields

key_findings.gemini_4_26b: 0/6 requests succeeded â€” persistently rate limited.
key_findings.gemini_4_31b: 1/6 requests succeeded (3rd delayed attempt) â€” effectively rate limited, not reliably usable.
key_findings.parallel_load: Running all models in parallel via Start-Job causes intermittent 429s even on reliable models. Sequential testing recommended for final validation.
key_findings.model_id_format: OpenRouter API calls should NOT use the 'openrouter/' prefix. Use 'provider/model:free' format.
key_findings.burst_vs_persistent: Most free models that 429 on first request also 429 on every subsequent request, even with 5s delays. This indicates persistent rate limiting, not just burst protection.
key_findings.single_call_insufficient: A single successful API call does NOT mean a model is not rate limited. Several models succeed once but fail on every subsequent request.
